topic: Unveiling the Beauty of Conic Sections: The Dandelin Spheres
target_audience: High school geometry or early university mathematics students

sections.title: Prerequisites: The Plane-Cone Intersection
lecture_lines: A double-napped cone is our starting shape.
A plane slices the cone at various angles.
Different angles create circles, ellipses, parabolas, hyperbolas.
animations: Display a cone [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/cone.svg] and a plane [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/plane.svg] on a black background (#000000).
Highlight intersection points as the plane [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/plane.svg] cuts the cone [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/cone.svg].
Change color to #FF5733 to emphasize the conic section.

sections.title: Introducing Dandelin Spheres
lecture_lines: Meet the Dandelin Spheres, a geometric bridge.
They fit perfectly inside the cone's interior.
They are tangent to both cone and plane.
animations: Display a [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/sphere.svg] inside the [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/cone.svg] touching the plane.
Show a second [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/sphere.svg] on the opposite side of the [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/cone.svg].
Highlight the points of tangency in #33FF57.

sections.title: Connecting the Dots: The Ellipse Proof
lecture_lines: Tangency points on the plane become the foci.
Distance sum to foci is constant for ellipses.
This length equals the distance between circles of tangency.
animations: Draw an ellipse formed by the intersection.
Add two points representing the foci derived from [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/sphere.svg].
Use lines in #33A1FF to connect points to foci.

sections.title: Generalization and Conclusion
lecture_lines: Parabolas and hyperbolas also use this tangency principle.
Shifting the plane morphs the resulting conic section.
Tangency remains the key to all conic behavior.
animations: Show the [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/plane.svg] tilting to create parabola and hyperbola.
Highlight how [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/sphere.svg] tangency generalizes across all conic sections.
Fade all elements to #FFFFFF for a clear conclusion.
